# OutdoorPainter

> OutdoorPainter is the digital hub for PleinAir Magazine, a community dedicated to plein air painting, outdoor art education, and celebrating contemporary landscape artists.

OutdoorPainter connects outdoor painters through PleinAir Magazine, educational guides, artist profiles, and events like Plein Air Convention and PleinAir Salon. The site serves as a resource for both beginners learning plein air fundamentals and established artists seeking inspiration and community.

## Key Topics

- Plein Air Painting
- Outdoor Art

## Core Resources

- [Home - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com): OutdoorPainter hub for Plein Air Magazine and community of outdoor painters
- [About Us - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/about-us): About OutdoorPainter and PleinAir Magazine by Streamline Publishing
- [PleinAir Magazine Subscription - PaintTube.tv](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/subscribe): Subscribe to PleinAir Magazine in print or digital editions
- [Your Plein Air Magazine Editorial Team - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/plein-air-magazine-editorial-team): Meet PleinAir Magazine's editorial team: Eric Rhoads, Kelly Kane, Cherie Dawn Haas
- [Plein Air Today - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/plein-air-today-newsletter): Free weekly newsletter for plein air painting advice and art news
- [PleinAir Collector - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/pleinair-collector): Browse plein air paintings featured in PleinAir Magazine and Salon

## Beginner's Guides

- [What is Plein Air Painting? - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/what-is-plein-air-painting): Beginner's guide explaining plein air painting fundamentals and techniques
- [What You Need to Paint Outdoors: The Beginner's Guide - OutdoorPainter](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/plein-air-painting-paint-outdoors-the-beginners-guide): Beginner's guide to outdoor painting supplies and equipment essentials
